Community Banks Sue OCC Over Crypto Trust Bank Charters | HTX InsightsHomeCrypto News深度研究Community Banks Sue OCC Over C...Community Banks Sue OCC Over Crypto Trust Bank ChartersTheNewsCryptoPublished on 2026-10-03Last updated on 2026-10-03AbstractThe Independent Community Bankers of America (ICBA) is suing the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) over its 2026 rule allowing cryptocurrency firms to obtain national trust bank charters. The lawsuit, filed in a Washington, D.C. district court, argues the OCC exceeded its authority under the National Bank Act. ICBA contends the rule creates an unfair regulatory gap, as these crypto trust banks—exempt from FDIC insurance and traditional capital requirements—can offer services like digital asset custody. The group also warns consumers may mistakenly believe assets held with these firms have federal protections like insured bank deposits. The suit seeks to invalidate the OCC's rule and reverse the conditional trust charter approval for Protego Holdings Corp., among other crypto firms previously approved by the OCC.
